text:
If you caught a stray shower this morning, that's already behind us. Skies are clearing out nicely, and the rest of the day is shaping up dry and pleasant, with sun winning out through the afternoon and a high near 85. Humidity stays manageable and the wind's light out of the west, so it should feel comfortable rather than sticky. There's a little wrinkle in the models, some are running wetter than what we're actually seeing, but I'm trusting the clearing skies outside my window over that signal for this afternoon.

The lake is in good shape too, winds under 15 knots and waves a foot or less, so it's a fine afternoon and evening to be out on the water, with water temps sitting near 78. Once the sun goes down, clouds increase a bit but it stays dry and comfortable, with lows dropping to around 65. Enjoy this stretch, because Monday brings a better shot at showers and storms by mid-afternoon into the evening. Good outdoor plans through sunset tonight; if you're on the water, no need to rush in early.

week.blurb: Sunny and pleasant with a high near 85, about as good as August gets around here.
Storm chances build through the day and models lean cooler and wetter than NWS, so keep the rain gear handy.
Mostly sunny and comfortable with a high near 82 once any early-morning sprinkle clears out.
Sunny most of the day, but watch for afternoon storms rolling in after 2pm with a high near 82.
A soaker of a day, showers and thunderstorms likely with a cooler high only near 79.
Cooler and mostly sunny with a high near 75, just a slight chance of a stray shower.
Mostly sunny and refreshingly cool to close the week, high near 76.
